label: Can off-hand hits proc Windfury Totem?
short: No. The totem's description says main-hand hits only.
description: Forever made the totem a raid aura. Its description still says "Each main hand hit has a 20% chance", as in Era.
source: Forever client 70425 (totem description).

settings.label: Main hand only
settings.value: only main-hand hits can proc it

label: How often does raid damage hit a DPS?
short: Each hit can fire a shield, give Rage or push back a cast.
description: By default each DPS takes 2 hits a minute of 1500 damage, from boss timers. The hits cost no health. They fire Lightning Shield (once per 3.5s), Water Shield or a Troll priest's Shadowguard, give a warrior about 9.2 Rage and a chance to Enrage, and push back casts.
source: SoD boss timers in Deadly Boss Mods (Ragnaros, Broodlord, Firemaw, Chromaggus, Huhuran, Kel'Thuzad, Sapphiron).

label: Does a Goblin Land Mine reset the swing?
short: Yes. Its 1s cast resets the swing, like other casts with a cast time.
description: Melee rotations throw it just after a main-hand swing. Client 70338 makes it instant, which would leave the swing alone and add about 1% DPS to melee builds.
source: wowsims/forever (casts reset the swing). Forever client 70338 (spell 4100).

settings.label: Resets the swing
settings.value: the 1s cast holds the swing and restarts it
settings.rationale: Casts with a cast time reset the swing.

label: Is the boss in Hyjal or Barrow Deeps?
short: Some flasks give their full bonus only there. The presets assume yes.
description: The Flasks of Natural Accuracy, Aggression, Precision and Swiftness give 60 Stamina anywhere. In Hyjal and the Barrow Deeps they also give 5% hit, 4% crit, 5% less chance to be dodged or parried, or 5% haste. Elsewhere, hunters and cat druids switch to the Flask of Distilled Wisdom, and the rest keep theirs for the Stamina.
source: Forever client (spells 1293740 to 1293743). wowsims/forever.

label: Do bosses partly resist spells by level?
short: No. Forever's resist formula ignores level, and beta mobs never partly resisted.
description: Classic bosses partly resisted about 6% of spell damage, 2% for each level above you. About 520 beta hits on mobs 3 to 5 levels up had no partial resists. Only school resistance causes them. No boss is tested yet.
source: Beta logs (0 partials in about 520 hits at +3 to +5). Forever's character sheet formula, 0.75 × resistance / (5 × caster level). wowsims/forever's logs (none in thousands of hits on mobs 1 to 9 levels up). Classic's level rule (royalgiraffe's resist guide).

settings.label: None
settings.rationale: Forever's resist formula and the beta logs.

label: Does haste shorten the GCD?
short: Classic keeps the GCD at 1.5s. Later expansions let spell haste shorten it.
description: The presets keep Classic's 1.5s GCD. wowsims/forever lets haste shorten a spell's GCD to 1s, from its Burning Crusade code, not a Forever test. Forever's Nature's Grace has its own 10% GCD cut, which hints that haste alone doesn't.
source: wowsims/forever (from its Burning Crusade code). Forever client (Nature's Grace, spell 16886).

settings.label: No (Classic)
settings.rationale: Classic's rule. Forever gives Nature's Grace its own GCD cut.

settings.label: Yes, for spells
settings.value: haste shortens a spell's GCD, down to 1s
settings.rationale: wowsims/forever's rule, from its Burning Crusade code.

label: How hard do bleed ticks crit?
short: 200%, like a melee crit.
description: Client 70425 lets bleed ticks crit, and wowsims/forever uses the melee crit size too. The only measured tick crits are spell ticks, at 150%.
source: Client 70425 (periodic crit on bleeds). wowsims/forever (the physical crit multiplier).

label: Do DoT ticks use your current stats?
short: Yes. Each tick uses your spell power, buffs and crit when it lands.
description: wowsims/forever found this in a Rend log and applies it to every DoT and channel. So a buff that ends mid-DoT lowers the ticks left, and one that starts raises them. Bane of Agony keeps its cast's spell power.
source: wowsims/forever (from a Rend log).

settings.label: Live ticks
settings.value: each tick reads spell power, damage buffs and crit when it lands

label: How often can Windfury Totem proc?
short: At most once every 0.1s, as Forever's game data has it.
description: Forever's game data gives Windfury Totem a 0.1s cooldown between procs, where Classic had 1.5s. Fast hitters like rogues and Fury warriors proc it more often. Still to be checked in game.
source: Forever client (Windfury Totem 10612, 0.1s between procs). wowsims/forever.

label: Do extra attacks reset the swing timer?
short: No. The next swing comes when it was due.
description: Windfury, Sword Specialization, Hand of Justice and other extra attacks hit at once and leave the main-hand timer alone, as wowsims/forever has it. In Classic they restarted it. This gives fast melee more white damage, and more rage to warriors. Still to be checked in game.
source: wowsims/forever (extra attacks as separate hits).

settings.label: Keeps the swing
settings.value: the next swing comes when it was due

label: Does regen stay low through a channel?
short: Yes, until the channel ends, even past 5s.
description: The five-second rule starts when you pay for a spell. wowsims/forever keeps it going until a paid channel ends, so a long Drain Soul or Blizzard regenerates less.
source: wowsims/forever.

settings.label: Until the channel ends
settings.value: casting-rate regen until the channel ends

label: Does Rage from hits grow with level?
short: No. A level 13 log matches what testers measured at 30.
description: A white hit gives 3.46 × weapon speed in Rage (4.5 for a two-hander) at every level. At 60 that is about half of Classic's Rage a swing.
source: Arlewow's level 13 combat log. Level 30 beta tests (forum thread 2355684). wowsims/forever (3.46 / 4.5, no level scaling).

settings.label: Flat (level 30 value)
settings.value: Rage per hit stays at its level 30 value

label: Do off-hand hits give full Rage?
short: No. Half the Rage of a main-hand hit of the same speed.
description: A beta log shows a 1.6s off-hand dagger giving 2.7 to 2.8 Rage a swing, glancing blows included. Dual Wield Specialization adds 10% a point on top.
source: Arlewow's level 13 combat log (magey/forever-warrior issue 3).

label: How much attack power does Rend get?
short: 2% of attack power a tick, about 14% over a full Rend.
description: Blizzard says Rend scales strongly with attack power, but the game data has no number. wowsims/forever measured 2% a tick on rank 2.
source: Blizzard's warrior notes. Forever client 70338. wowsims/forever (rank 2 logs at levels 13 and 14: 7 + 0.02 × attack power a tick).

label: Do stances change Rage from hits taken?
short: No. Rage comes from the hit before your own mitigation.
description: The logs fit Rage from the hit before the defender's health, armor or gear count. The sim counts no stance, Shield Wall, Recklessness or block, only crits and crushing blows.
source: wowsims/forever (logs from after 8 October, geared and with no gear). Blizzard's 8 October notes.

settings.label: None
settings.value: the attacker's hit, before anything of ours

label: Rage from a hit taken at 60
short: About 9.2 Rage from a 1500 hit, measured on melee hits.
description: The sim gives 2.5 × (1 − armor) × damage ÷ the Rage conversion at the attacker's level, with 40% armor for a level 63 attacker. Raid hits are spells, and spell hits gave 1 to 2 times as much in the logs.
source: wowsims/forever (combat logs: spell ticks about 2×, Fireball about 1.2×). Blizzard's 8 October notes.

settings.label: 2.5 (melee fit)
settings.value: 9.2 Rage for a 1500 hit from the boss

label: How much attack power does Eviscerate add?
short: 4% of attack power for each combo point.
description: wowsims/forever's estimate from the game. Classic added 3% a combo point. Still to be checked in game.
source: wowsims/forever.

settings.label: 4% a combo point
settings.value: 4% of attack power for each combo point

label: How much does the pet inherit?
short: 10% of your attack power, plus your crit and hit.
description: A level 17 pet sheet shows the attack power and crit. Blizzard says the pet's melee hit is your ranged hit, and its spell hit 17/8 of it.
source: wowsims/forever (pet sheets). forever-bugs #394.

settings.label: 10% attack power + hit
settings.value: 10% of ranged attack power, the hunter's crit and hit, 17/8 of the hit as spell hit

label: Do faster pets hit for less?
short: Yes. Faster pets hit for less, so all pets deal the same white DPS.
description: Some beta players saw every pet hit like a 2.0s pet. A level 17 Cat sheet at 1.5s fits Classic's rule instead.
source: wowsims/forever (level 17 Cat sheet). Beta players (ForeverChanges' hunter pets page, forever-hunter wiki).

settings.label: Scales with speed (Classic)
settings.value: a fast pet's hits are smaller
settings.rationale: The level 17 pet sheet fits it.

label: How much does Cobra Reflexes cut pet hits?
short: Hits shrink by the 30% speed gain, so white DPS stays the same.
description: The tooltip says it "reduces damage" but gives no number. The gain is then only Pet Aggression's 8 a hit on the extra swings, and more procs. wowsims/forever uses The Burning Crusade's 15% cut, which gives 10.5% more white damage.
source: Forever client 70532 (spell 25076). wowsims/forever (The Burning Crusade's 15% cut).

settings.label: Hits shrink with speed
settings.value: each hit ×1/1.3, the same white damage a second
settings.rationale: The same as pet attack speed.

label: Trueshot Aura's top rank at 60
short: +50 ranged attack power. A hotfix put ranks 1 to 4 below it.
description: A 28 October hotfix lowered ranks 1 to 4 to 15, 22, 30 and 40, below rank 5's 50. The same hotfix halved Aspect of the Hawk, so its rank 6 (55) is now its best. A server hotfix set Hunter's Mark to 143.
source: Forever client 70338 to 70658 (Trueshot Aura rank 5: 50). Launch-realm hotfix seen 2026-10-28 (foreverchanges.pro). Hunter's Mark 143: server hotfix seen 2026-10-21.

label: Hunter crit per Agility at 60
short: 53 Agility per 1% crit, as in Classic.
description: Lower levels get more crit per Agility: 22% more at level 1, 5% more at 20, and none from about 40. Level 1 beta sheets showed this.
source: Forever client 70532 (expected stats table). Level 1 beta character sheets (10 October).

label: Will Raptor Strike's top rank get a raise?

description: The level 24 rank keeps 0.88 of Era's flat bonus. Ranks past 30 keep only 0.50 to 0.70, and the top rank has +70.
source: Forever client 70338.

label: How much attack power do Fire traps get?
short: 10% of ranged attack power per trap, spread over its ticks.
description: Blizzard's 15 October notes say Fire traps now scale with attack power, but give no number. Immolation Trap gets 2% a tick, and Explosive Trap's hit another 10%.
source: wowsims/forever. Blizzard's 15 October notes. Forever client 70425 (spells 14301, 14315).
